introLine: Stop losing money on construction bids. LV Scout automates the entire review and pricing cycle.
outroLine: From raw data to final offer—master your construction bidding with LV Scout.

artDirection.backdropSvg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 720" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
    <defs>
        <!-- Define Neon Glow Effect -->
        <filter id="neonGlow">
            <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur"/>
            <feMerge>
                <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
                <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
            </feMerge>
        </filter>
        <!-- Background Grid Pattern (Subtle) -->
        <pattern id="grid" width="80" height="80" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
            <path d="M 80 0 L 0 0 0 80" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.05"/>
        </pattern>
    </defs>

    <!-- 1. Dark Cyber City Silhouette Background -->
    <rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#0a0a1a"/>

    <!-- Background Skyscrapers (Silhouettes) -->
    <g opacity="0.4">
        <!-- Left Cluster -->
        <polygon points="100,100 250,100 250,400 100,400" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
        <polygon points="350,150 500,150 500,350 350,350" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
        <!-- Right Cluster -->
        <polygon points="1000,200 1150,200 1150,450 1000,450" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
        <polygon points="900,300 1050,300 1050,500 900,500" fill="#1a1a3a"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 2. Primary Circuit Lines & Data Streams (Foreground Detail) -->
    
    <!-- Main Flow Line (Represents the Cycle Start/End) -->
    <path d="M 150 360 C 400 100, 800 500, 1130 360" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="4" filter="url(#neonGlow)" opacity="0.8"/>

    <!-- Secondary Circuit Traces -->
    <line x1="150" y1="50" x2="1130" y2="670" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6"/>
    <line x1="150" y1="670" x2="1130" y2="50" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6"/>

    <!-- Abstract Data Streams (Glowing Paths) -->
    <path d="M 200 100 Q 400 200, 600 150" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.2"/>
    <path d="M 800 600 Q 1000 550, 1100 650" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.2"/>
    <path d="M 450 300 L 650 350 L 650 450 L 450 400 Z" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.15"/>


    <!-- 3. Cycle Representation (Abstract Nodes/Process Markers) -->
    
    <!-- Node 1: Bill of Quantities (BOQ) -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="350" r="25" fill="#00ffff" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="350" r="15" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- Node 2: Review Findings -->
    <circle cx="600" cy="250" r="20" fill="#00ffff" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
    <circle cx="600" cy="250" r="10" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- Node 3: Evaluate Prices -->
    <circle cx="850" cy="450" r="25" fill="#00ffff" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
    <circle cx="850" cy="450" r="15" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- Node 4: Set Margin -->
    <circle cx="1050" cy="300" r="20" fill="#00ffff" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
    <circle cx="1050" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- Node 5: Export (Connecting back to start) -->
    <circle cx="1130" cy="360" r="25" fill="#00ffff" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#neonGlow)"/>
    <circle cx="1130" cy="360" r="15" fill="#ff00ff" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- 4. Peripheral Framing Elements (Top Skyline & Left Margin Detail) -->
    
    <!-- Top Skyline Accent (Left Side) -->
    <rect x="15" y="12" width="130" height="80" fill="none" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.1"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="12" x2="145" y2="12" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.1"/>

    <!-- Left Margin Circuit Detail -->
    <path d="M 15 40 H 145" stroke="#00ffff" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.2"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="40" x2="145" y2="40" stroke="#ff00ff" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.2"/>

    <!-- Subtle Background Geometric Framing (Full Canvas Opacity) -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#grid)" opacity="0.08"/>

</svg>
